title: Student assistant for Protein Research
location: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
description_md:
**Location:** **Måløv, Denmark**

**Department:** **Protein Research 1**

**Your impact begins here**

As a Student Assistant in Protein Research, you will keep laboratory work moving in a team that develops early-stage biotherapeutics and tool reagents. You will prepare buffers, register samples for freezer storage and support day-to-day lab tasks, so scientists and technicians can focus on discovery. It is practical, hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry, one day a week, alongside your studies.

**What you’ll bring**

You are a first- or second-year bachelor student in natural sciences who wants hands-on lab experience.

* You are currently a first- or second-year bachelor student within natural sciences.
* You have a good understanding of basic chemistry.
* You are dedicated and have a quality mindset.
* You have basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
* You collaborate well and take a flexible approach to daily tasks.
* You can work one day a week (up to 8 hours), with flexibility around your studies, courses and exams.

**What you’ll do**

You will be a practical support to the laboratory, working under the supervision of a lab technician who will train you and coordinate your tasks.

* Prepare buffers for the team’s laboratory work.
* Register samples for freezer storage.
* Support general laboratory tasks as they arise.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Department of Protein Research in Måløv, part of the Protein and Peptide Research area within Therapeutics Discovery. In Research & Development, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. Curiosity, data, technology and collaboration come together to help meet future health needs.

The department focuses on technologies for early discovery and engineering of recombinant biotherapeutics and tool reagents across Novo’s portfolio. It has 28 scientists, technicians and PhD students or post docs, organised in two collaborative teams that share laboratories and office space.

Your day-to-day supervisor is a lab technician. Close collaboration between scientists and technicians is central here, so you will see how the work fits together.

**What you can expect here**

You will learn on the job from experienced colleagues, build practical laboratory skills and see how a pharmaceutical research environment works. You will join an inclusive team culture that supports learning and development, and where your contribution is trusted and valued.

**Salary:** the hourly salary is DKK 209.27. In addition, you will have access to Novo canteens, holiday houses and a fitness centre.

Expected start date: January/February 2027.

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring care and curiosity to the lab, apply by **10 December 2026**.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
